098e0055f9b4cc74a614908ae8ba60bd345f8271.summary: A post sharing samples of the Gauss malware, described in its title as nation-state cyber-surveillance and a banking trojan. It lists archived .ocx files. It says the highest number of infections is in Lebanon, with more than 1600 computers affected, and that the code contains commands to intercept data for Lebanese banks, including Bank of Beirut, Byblos Bank and Fransabank.
